consolidated_finding: The KU layer shows that Glen Canyon Dam and the Colorado River Storage Project support multiple operating purposes: regulating Colorado River flows, storing and delivering water, generating hydropower, maintaining drought buffer storage, and supporting environmental or downstream conditions.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
source_coverage_note: Supported by 5 KUs from 4 source records: LP-20260626-A-002, LP-20260626-A-006, LP-20260626-A-015, LP-20260626-A-021.
title: Lake Powell operation is framed around storage, delivery, hydropower, drought buffer, and environmental purposes.

consolidated_finding: The KU layer preserves several rule layers: Mid-Elevation Release Tier values, WY2026 release adjustments, the 8.23 maf minimum objective release under long-range criteria, 24-Month Study release scenarios, and CRSS logic for setting operating tiers and annual releases.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
title: Operation rules include release tiers, objective releases, drought-response reductions, and model-based operating decisions.

consolidated_finding: The KUs repeatedly identify physical constraints including the 3,490-foot minimum power pool, penstock limits, river outlet works, dead-pool-related elevations, release capacity, and low-water operational issues when releases can no longer use hydropower pathways.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
title: Low-water infrastructure and release pathways are central to Lake Powell operations.

consolidated_finding: The KUs show operational responses under drought conditions, including DROA planning, additional releases from upstream initial units such as Flaming Gorge, and reduced annual releases from Lake Powell to protect critical elevations and respond to projected low storage.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
title: Drought-response operations use upstream releases and Lake Powell release reductions to protect critical elevations.

consolidated_finding: The KUs identify governance mechanisms that shape operations, including Reclamation and DOI authorities, Colorado River Basin State coordination, compact context, 2007 Interim Guidelines, DCP/DROA, NEPA review, LTEMP/adaptive management, and Post-2026 rule development.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
title: Lake Powell operations are governed through layered federal, basin-state, compact, NEPA, DCP, DROA, LTEMP, and Post-2026 processes.

consolidated_finding: The KU layer captures current and scenario-based operational data, including unregulated inflow forecasts, May/June 2026 24-Month Study outputs, most probable/probable minimum/probable maximum scenarios, projected Lake Powell elevations, storage percentages, and release volumes.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
source_coverage_note: Supported by 10 KUs from 4 source records: LP-20260626-A-001, LP-20260626-A-012, LP-20260626-A-013, LP-20260626-A-016.
title: Operational data centers on inflow forecasts, 24-Month Study scenarios, elevations, storage, and release projections.

consolidated_finding: The KU layer identifies technical and research materials used to understand operations and impacts, including CRSS modeling of releases/elevations/power generation, DMDU and uncertainty methods, hydrologic modeling, high-flow or disturbance-flow experiments, and long-term water-temperature datasets below Glen Canyon Dam.
notes: Consolidates source-grounded KUs under the updated Stage 3 two-step synthesis protocol.
title: Research and modeling evidence includes CRSS, DMDU, hydrologic models, flow experiments, and water-temperature datasets.

consolidated_finding: The KUs show hydrologic uncertainty, future operating uncertainty, modeling assumptions, and DMDU methods. The evidence is strong that uncertainty matters, but the current KU set is thinner on exactly how uncertainty is translated into enforceable thresholds, trigger logic, or final Post-2026 operating decisions.
notes: This is a source-corpus evidence gap, not a workflow/table-parsing limitation.
title: The source corpus identifies uncertainty, but some operational translation from uncertainty to rules remains under-specified.
